sections.heading: Meryl Streep — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Meryl Streep was born on 22 June 1949 in Summit, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Mary Louise Streep at birth and is publicly known as Meryl Streep.
Public records name her mother, Mary Wilkinson Streep.
Her listed education includes Vassar College, Yale University, Yale School of Drama and Bernards High School.
She is recorded as speaking English.
